sources.title: [2001.07852] DeepRS: Deep-learning Based Network-Adaptive FEC for Real ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose DeepRS, a deep learning based FEC system for real-time video streaming which mainly consists of two parts, LSTM model and RS encoder. DeepRS embeds an LSTM model inside and solves the problem of predicting the number of lost packets in the near future according to the historical packet loss pattern.
